نتماسس (form VI)
# نَتَمَاسَسُ (natamāsasu) /na.ta.maː.sa.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَمَاسَسَ (tamāsasa)
# نَتَمَاسَسَ (natamāsasa) /na.ta.maː.sa.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَمَاسَسَ (tamāsasa)
# نَتَمَاسَسْ (natamāsas) /na.ta.maː.sas/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَمَاسَسَ (tamāsasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
